# 🌐 GitHub Pages Setup

## ✅ GitHub Pages is Now Enabled!

Your repository is now published as a GitHub Pages site!

### 📍 Site URL
**https://noxfund.github.io/noxfund/**

### ⚙️ Configuration

- **Source Branch:** `main`
- **Source Path:** `/` (root)
- **Build Type:** Legacy (Jekyll)
- **HTTPS:** Enabled (enforced)
- **Public:** Yes

### 🚀 What Happens Next?

1. **Build Process:** GitHub will automatically build your site (takes 1-2 minutes)
2. **Live Site:** Your site will be available at the URL above
3. **Auto-Deploy:** Every push to `main` branch will automatically rebuild the site

### 📂 Files Served

Since your source is the root directory, GitHub Pages will serve:
- `index.html` as the homepage
- All HTML files in the root
- Assets from `assets/` folder
- Any other static files

### 🎨 Custom Domain (Optional)

To use a custom domain like `docs.nox.fund`:

1. Go to: https://github.com/noxfund/noxfund/settings/pages
2. Under "Custom domain", enter your domain
3. Add a CNAME record in your DNS settings pointing to: `noxfund.github.io`
4. Wait for DNS propagation and GitHub verification

### 🔧 Troubleshooting

**Site not loading?**
- Wait 1-2 minutes for initial build
- Check: https://github.com/noxfund/noxfund/settings/pages for build status
- Ensure `index.html` exists in root
- Check browser console for errors

**Update not showing?**
- Clear browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+R / Cmd+Shift+R)
- Wait for GitHub Actions to complete build
- Check deployment status in Actions tab

### 📊 Deployment Status

Check your deployments at:
**https://github.com/noxfund/noxfund/deployments**
